blocks.text: IBA, Zambales — Six wild animals were released into a forested area of Aurora Memorial National Park, a protected area spanning parts of Aurora and Nueva Ecija provinces, after undergoing rehabilitation, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Central Luzon said on Tuesday. Artemio Almazan Jr., head of the DENR’s Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office in Nueva Ecija, said three Philippine cobras (Naja philippinensis), two reticulated pythons (Malayopython reticulatus), and a Philippine scops owl (Otus megalotis) were turned over to the DENR Regional Wildlife Rescue Center (RWRC) by field offices and local governments for proper care and rehabilitation before […]...
